title: Polynomial local mass for regular orthogonality measures
established: For every fixed $L>2$, the capacity of ambient ball centers with local mass at least $r^L$ tends to the support capacity. This implies the requested iterated limit.
scope_or_remaining: The conclusion concerns exactly the catalogue target; no historical priority claim is made.
author: Matthew J. Colbrook
outcome: The required capacity limit holds for every fixed exponent greater than two, with ambient ball centers.
